title: Citi’s Global Credit Head on Risks in Private Credit

title: Blue Owl, HPS Join Private Credit Funds Stung by February Losses

title: Oracle Credit Risk Measure Hits Record High on AI-Debt Fears
content: A gauge of Oracle Corp.’s credit risk closed at an all-time high Friday, the latest sign that investors are growing increasingly wary about the technology giant’s heavy debt load amid rising oil prices and falling stock prices.

title: SEC Division Overseeing Private Credit Firms Lost 24% of Staff
content: Nearly a quarter of the staff in the Securities and Exchange Commission’s division overseeing hedge funds, private credit firms, mutual funds and many investment products, left the agency last year, according to a new report.
